settings.title: Returns & Refunds Overview
settings.content:
3 Delta Dental is committed to supplying high-quality dental lab materials that meet your expectations. If you are not satisfied with your purchase, please review our returns policy below and contact us to arrange a resolution.

Contact: info@3deltadental.com | 0448 419 050

settings.title: Return Eligibility
settings.content:
You may be eligible to return a product if:

  • The item is faulty, damaged, or not as described
  • You received the wrong product
  • The product does not comply with applicable TGA or Australian Standards

Returns are generally accepted within 30 days of the delivery date. Items must be unused, in original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase.

settings.title: Non-Returnable Items
settings.content:
The following items cannot be returned unless they are faulty or not as described:

  • Opened or partially used consumable materials (e.g. acrylics, impression materials)
  • Custom-ordered or special-order products
  • Products that have been specifically cut or modified
  • Items that have passed their expiry or use-by date after delivery

settings.title: How to Return an Item
settings.content:
To initiate a return, please follow these steps:

  1. Contact us within 30 days of delivery at info@3deltadental.com or 0448 419 050
  2. Provide your order number, a description of the issue, and photographs if relevant
  3. Our team will assess your request and provide a Return Merchandise Authorisation (RMA) number if approved
  4. Pack the item securely in its original packaging, include the RMA number, and ship to our address
  5. Once received and inspected, we will process your refund or replacement within 5-10 business days

settings.title: Return Shipping Costs
settings.content:
Faulty or incorrect items: 3 Delta Dental will cover the cost of return shipping and provide a prepaid label where possible.

Change of mind returns: The customer is responsible for return shipping costs. We recommend using a tracked service as we cannot be held responsible for items lost in transit.

settings.title: Refunds
settings.content:
Approved refunds will be processed to the original payment method within 5-10 business days of us receiving and inspecting the returned item. You will receive an email confirmation once your refund has been processed.

Original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error or a faulty product.

settings.title: Australian Consumer Law
settings.content: Our goods come with guarantees that cannot be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law. You are entitled to a replacement or refund for a major failure and compensation for any other reasonably foreseeable loss or damage. You are also entitled to have the goods repaired or replaced if they fail to be of acceptable quality and the failure does not amount to a major failure.
